founder_compounding_definition.closed_balance_compounding: Fresh position sizing must compound from the current realized closed account balance. Realized gains increase the next balance-based sizing amount and realized losses reduce it.
founder_compounding_definition.floating_pnl_rule: Unrealized mark-to-market profit must not enlarge the balance base used to size a fresh position.
founder_compounding_definition.position_compounding: Additional or expanded exposure remains conditional on the existing Quant V2 strategy, campaign, risk, exposure and execution rules.
